meta.title: Said Hammoudi | Freelance Cloud Ops & Platform Engineer
meta.description: Freelance Cloud Ops and Platform Engineer (ex-Decathlon, ADEO) for long-term missions. I run and evolve multi-cloud platforms on GCP, AWS and Azure with Terraform, automation and on-call ownership.
meta.ogTagline: Freelance, for long-term missions on GCP, AWS and Azure

hero.title: Cloud Ops and Platform Engineering, for the long run.
hero.subtitle: I join your platform team for months, not days. I operate and evolve multi-cloud platforms on GCP, AWS and Azure, with infrastructure as code, automation and real ownership of run and on-call.
hero.availability: Remote, Paris and Lille · Missions of 6 months and more

services.title: What I take on
services.subtitle: The scope of a typical long-term mission.

items.title: Cloud operations
items.text: Day-to-day ownership of multi-cloud environments: incident handling, L3 support and on-call, change management and continuous improvement of the run.

items.title: Platform engineering
items.text: Landing zones, networking, IAM and guardrails on GCP, AWS and Azure, built as reusable Terraform modules that product teams can adopt.

items.title: Automation and delivery
items.text: CI/CD with GitHub Actions and automated infrastructure testing with terraform test and pytest, so changes ship safely and quickly.

items.title: Internal tooling and APIs
items.text: Self-service provisioning APIs in Python and FastAPI, and custom Terraform providers in Go, to remove tickets and manual steps.
